title: Deep Temporal Reasoning in Video Language Models: A Cross-Linguistic Evaluation of Action Duration and Completion through Perfect Times

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model accuracy, F1 scores, and error patterns on a multimodal temporal reasoning benchmark across four languages (English, Italian, Russian, and Japanese) to identify performance disparities caused by training data imbalances and differences in grammatical encodings.

Analyzing the frequency of models selecting specific multiple-choice answer options (e.g., heavily favoring the first or second option 'a0' or 'a1') to evaluate systematic selection biases that occur independently of the models' actual temporal reasoning capabilities.
